Definition: disgusting, i.e. filthy; especially idolatrous or (concretely) an idol
BiblicalUsage: Moses warns Israel not to bring the abominations of the nations into their houses, Solomon's heart turns after the abominations of Milcom and Chemosh, Josiah breaks down the high places of the abominations, and Asa takes the abominations out of the land. The word is the idol itself, named as God sees it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Bible calls an idol an abomination because it steals the worship that belongs to God alone. I hold that the kings who removed them are my pattern, and the king who kept them is my warning.
